presets.name: Story
presets.description: Slower hunger and thirst, softer bites, fewer and duller-eyed creatures, fewer elites, kinder tools, richer foraging and a gentler monsoon chill.

presets.name: Survival
presets.description: The intended journey. Nothing is changed.

presets.name: Hard
presets.description: Faster hunger and thirst, harder bites, more and sharper-eyed creatures, more elites, faster tool wear, leaner foraging and a colder monsoon.

modifiers.name: Lean Season
modifiers.description: The forest gives less: foraging yields are reduced and hunger comes sooner.

modifiers.name: Restless Nights
modifiers.description: More creatures stir after dark, and they notice you from further away.

modifiers.name: Brittle Tools
modifiers.description: Tools and weapons wear out much faster.

modifiers.name: Parched Earth
modifiers.description: Thirst builds faster, so clean water matters more.

modifiers.name: Cold Monsoon
modifiers.description: The monsoon chills deeper; staying warm and dry matters more.

modifiers.name: Wary Forest
modifiers.description: Elite creatures appear more often, but never bite harder.
